about: Gate for bench/plan-exec/run.mjs over corpus.json (the plan-exec workflow). A run fails when a project cannot be run or a scan stays NOT CHECKED, when any step fails, lowers a version that was installed or that an earlier step set, or names a command the harness does not run, when the plan has no run_order, when fewer advisories are cleared than min_net_cleared_ratio ((before - after) / before over the corpus), or when the rescan contradicts more of the plan's claims than max_planned_but_remained (vulnerable copies a step ran for that were still there) or max_new_vulnerable_copies (vulnerable copies the run brought in) allow, summed over the corpus. Measured on 2026-11-23 with this harness: the 6.5.0 candidate's run_order, commands only, 281 steps, 0 failed, 0 lowering, 1,198 -> 288 (0.7595), 22 planned copies remained and 24 new vulnerable copies over 14 projects; published 6.4.0, whose rows the harness ran including its hand edits, 362 steps run, 10 failed, 8 lowering, 1,198 -> 308 (0.7429). min_net_cleared_ratio sits just under the 6.5.0 measurement; raise it to what a release measures in the change that records that run. max_planned_but_remained and max_new_vulnerable_copies hold the candidate's recorded 22 and 24 until the lead sets them to what the fixed build measures over the whole corpus. Advisory counts drift as OSV.dev adds records for these old versions: compare a ratio, never a count. Set on 2026-11-23 to what the 6.5.0 code measured over the 15 projects (uptime-kuma 1.23.0 added): 341 steps, 0 failed, 1,548 -> 340 (0.7803), 24 planned copies remained, 26 new vulnerable copies, and 1 lowering that no plan can avoid (uptime-kuma: cypress 15 pins cli-table3 0.6.1 exactly, 0.6.3 was installed; neither has an advisory). Lower these when a release measures lower; never raise them to pass.
